metadata.title: Regularity of $Q$-valued $C^1$ harmonic functions with applications to stable minimal hypersurfaces
metadata.abstract: We show that the derivative of a $Q$-valued $C^1$ function on an $n$-dimensional domain that is locally harmonic on its regular set is locally Dirichlet minimising, and that its branch set coincides with that of its derivative. As a consequence, we get that a $Q$-valued $C^1$ harmonic function is $C^{1,\alpha}$ and that its branch set is countably $(n-2)$-rectifiable when $n\geq 3$ and discrete when $n=2$. Our methods are directly applicable to the regularity theory of stable minimal hypersurfaces. We show that a multi-valued Lipschitz function whose graph is a two-sided, properly immersed, stable minimal $n$-dimensional hypersurface with locally $\mathcal{H}^{n-2}$-finite singular set, and whose Lipschitz constant is sufficiently small is in fact multi-valued $C^{1,\alpha}$. As a consequence, we obtain optimal regularity conclusions for a branched sheeting theorem of Bellettini for singular immersions. When $n=2$, we obtain stronger conclusions and show that locally about a branch point, a $Q$-valued $C^1$ harmonic function is the real part of a Dirichlet minimiser which is itself obtained from a finite number of holomorphic functions via classical branching, thus giving a full series expansion for the function near the branch point. Furthermore, we prove that the class of branched, two-sided, properly immersed, stable minimal surfaces with isolated singularities is compact under varifold convergence.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 多值调和函数与稳定极小超曲面的分支正则性
analysis.workSummary: Q 值 C¹ 调和函数的导数局部 Dirichlet 极小，并有相同分支集。所得 C¹,ᵅ 改进在 n=2 给 α=1/Q，在 Q=2 给 α=1/2，分支集在 n≥3 可数 (n−2) 可求长、在 n=2 离散。正文另给二维全纯分支表达、平稳 W²,² 小斜率多值图正则性和带零 2-容量奇异集的稳定曲面紧致性。
techniques: 按 Q 归纳与分支集零 2-容量
外变分平稳性、零 Lagrangian 与导数极小性
稳定极小超曲面的分层及 varifold 紧致性
analysis.breakthrough: 导数的变分极小性使分支集和正则性可借用 Dirichlet 极小多值理论，进一步给出小斜率平稳图与分支 sheeting 的正则性。
analysis.limitations: 一般 n≥3、Q≥3 的最佳 Hölder 指数仍待确定。小斜率平稳图定理另要求 W²,²，正文明确列出缺此条件时的反例。稳定曲面紧致性带质量与奇异集容量假设。已核对主陈述和关键命题，未逐步核验全证。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露公开可用 LLM 深度参与定理3.13的初始证明，发现命题2.4中的泛函为零 Lagrangian，协助部分附录论证及错误检查。作者声明正文文字由人类撰写。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.14409v1 · PDF 第8页 AI Statement；第11、23页具体数学结果
